title: Super Spectral preset
description: One analysis preset, loaded by the watch from the LittleFS `presets` partition and by the host from `protocols/presets/`. Normative prose: protocols/specs/preset-schema.md (ADR 0010). Rules that arithmetic cannot express in JSON Schema (V1-V10) live in that document.

schema_version.description: Major version of this schema the file conforms to. A loader accepts major 1 and rejects anything else; it never coerces.

id.description: Stable identifier. MUST equal the file's basename without the .json suffix (rule V1). Referenced from TAKE_HEADER together with the sha256 of this file.

name.description: Short label for the preset picker.

targets.description: Which half of the companion architecture may run this preset (ADR 0002). A host-only preset is never offered by the watch UI and never selected by a take.

guidance.description: Environment rules of thumb for this preset (distance, expected floor, clipping headroom), shown once when the preset is selected.

provisional.description: JSON Pointers to fields whose values are provisional - the repository's `(prov.)` marker, machine-readable. Every pointer MUST resolve (rule V10).

allOf.$comment: V2 - a watch preset stays inside the internal-SRAM envelope and the display ceiling.

sample_rate_hz.$comment: ADR 0003 decision 5: 48 kHz is gated on the PDM clock test (roadmap T3). Until it runs, no watch preset may ask for it.

allOf.$comment: V3 - the host block belongs to a preset that runs on the host.
V4 - a logarithmic frequency axis cannot start at zero.
V5 - `smoothing` is the exponential-averaging coefficient and is meaningless without it.
V6 - linear (Welch) averaging needs a frame count; nothing else may carry one.

sample_rate_hz.description: Nominal PCM rate. 48000 is RESERVED until experiment 0001 clause 4 passes (ADR 0003 decision 5): the V2 branch above rejects it for any preset targeting the watch, and the watch loader repeats the check because a preset can also arrive over the wire. A host-only preset may use it today.

fft_size.description: Real transform length N. 16384 is host-only: 224 KB of internal SRAM is the watch's hard ceiling.

interval_ms.description: Analysis hop in milliseconds. `interval_ms * sample_rate_hz` MUST be an integer multiple of 1000 so the hop is a whole number of samples (rule V7).

decimations.description: Spectroid-style decimation cascade depth; stage k analyses at sample_rate_hz / 2^k. 0 disables the cascade.

spectrum_type.description: What the dB axis shows. `psd` divides by the ENBW and is the correct choice for noise; `power_spectrum` is the correct choice for tones. ADR 0006 fixes the scaling constants; the preset only names which of the two it displays.

db_reference.description: dBFS referenced to a full-scale SINE, not a full-scale square (the 3.01 dB trap in docs/validation/golden-files.md).

averaging_frames.description: Number of frames in a linear (Welch) average.

smoothing.description: Exponential-averaging coefficient. Upper bound 0.95 follows Spectroid's documented range.

weighting.description: Frequency weighting applied to level readouts only, never to the displayed spectrum. Relative dBFS in every case - no calibrator is in the chain.

dc_blocker_hz.description: Corner of the software DC blocker in the capture path (ADR 0003 decision 6; the S3 has no hardware PDM high-pass). Recorded in TAKE_HEADER so the host applies the same filter.

window.description: The analysis window itself. Coefficients are the cosine-sum a_k of the named family; the watch generates the PERIODIC form (esp-dsp's dsps_wind_* are symmetric - ADR 0018).

name.$comment: NAME TRAP, measured 2026-08-21. These names identify the coefficient sets in preset-schema.md section 4.3 and NOTHING ELSE; never resolve them through a library. (a) scipy.signal.windows.nuttall is [0.3635819, 0.4891775, 0.1365995, 0.0106411] -- SciPy's `nuttall` IS this enum's `blackman_nuttall`, and this enum's `nuttall` [0.355768, 0.487396, 0.144232, 0.012604] has no SciPy name; building it via get_window('nuttall') is 0.0163 wrong at every sample. (b) Praat has none of these except hann: Sound_multiplyByWindow offers rectangular, triangular, parabolic, Hanning, Hamming, Gaussian and Kaiser only. The `coefficients` array in this same object is the contract; a loader MUST use it (rule V8) and MUST NOT look the name up anywhere.

coherent_gain.description: a0. Divide a tone's magnitude by this. MUST equal coefficients[0] (rule V8).

enbw_bins.description: Normalised equivalent noise bandwidth in bins (Heinzel 2002 NENBW). MUST equal (a0^2 + sum_{k>=1} a_k^2 / 2) / a0^2 (rule V8).

resolution.description: What the (window, fft_size, sample_rate_hz) triple buys. Every field is derived and re-checked on load (rule V9) - it is stored so a take manifest is self-describing without the window table.

enbw_hz.description: enbw_bins * bin_width_hz - the analysis bandwidth of this preset. This field is the reason the schema exists: 'wideband' and 'narrowband' are undefined without it.

mic_eq.description: The microphone-correction slot (ADR 0003 decision 7 - the only permitted non-linear-free conditioning is linear, minimum-phase and declared). `none` until experiment 0001 produces a fitted curve.

oneOf.$comment: Reference to an EQ filed at eq/<eq_id>.json on the same partition.
Coefficients carried in the preset itself. design_sample_rate_hz MUST equal analysis.sample_rate_hz (rule V6b).

scope.description: Whether this curve is a per-part-number constant or a per-unit calibration. A per-unit EQ makes band readouts non-reproducible on a second watch without a calibration step.

biquads.description: Cascaded transposed-direct-form-II sections, RBJ sign convention, a0 == 1 (the esp-dsp dsps_biquad_f32 coefficient order).

freq_max_hz.description: MUST be > freq_min_hz and <= sample_rate_hz / 2 (rule V9).

refresh_hz_target.description: Frames pushed to the panel per second. 50 is the measured ceiling of the hardware-scrolled analyzer canvas. 1000 / interval_ms MUST be an integer multiple of this (rule V7).

colormap_id.description: Deliberately an open string, not an enum: ADR 0011 fixes the map and the RGB565 LUT. Absent means 'the firmware default'.

host.description: Offline-only parameters. Meaningless on the watch and rejected there.
